how: ElevenLabs → Sound Effects (model v3): paste the prompt, set the duration (ambiences: Loop on), Generate, download the MP3 and drop it into its box in the Video Maker (or save it in Video_Maker/SFX with this name). Or run python tools/make_sfx.py.

whoosh.label: 💨 వూష్ (జూమ్ మార్పు)
whoosh.prompt: Fast cinematic whoosh transition, a deep air swoosh passing quickly from left to right, clean and smooth, no music

swish.label: 🍃 మెల్లని స్విష్ (స్లైడ్ మార్పు)
swish.prompt: Soft gentle swish, like silk cloth sweeping through the air, subtle cinematic transition, no music

shimmer.label: ✨ దివ్య మెరుపు (శ్లోకం మొదలు)
shimmer.prompt: Divine magical shimmer, soft sparkling chimes rising into a warm bright glow, Indian temple feel, short, no music

bell.label: 🔔 గుడి గంట
bell.prompt: One small Indian temple bell ring with a long, soft, peaceful decay

boom.label: 💥 లోతైన బూమ్ (ముగింపు ముందు)
boom.prompt: Deep cinematic boom impact with a low rumble tail, dramatic but not too loud, no music

amb_forest.label: 🌳 అడవి
amb_forest.prompt: Peaceful South Indian forest in the morning: koels and small songbirds calling, bulbuls chirping, leaves rustling in a soft breeze, a gentle stream far away. Natural field recording, no music, no voices.

amb_river.label: 🏞️ నది
amb_river.prompt: Clear shallow river flowing gently over smooth stones, soft bubbling and trickling water, a few distant birds. Calm natural field recording, no music, no voices.

amb_fire.label: 🔥 అగ్ని
amb_fire.prompt: Large wood fire burning steadily outdoors: warm crackling and popping logs, the soft roar of the flames. Close natural recording, no music, no voices.

amb_ocean.label: 🌊 సముద్రం
amb_ocean.prompt: Ocean waves rolling onto a sandy shore and pulling back over pebbles, steady surf and a light sea wind. Natural field recording, no music, no voices, no boats.

amb_battle.label: ⚔️ యుద్ధభూమి
amb_battle.prompt: Ancient battlefield heard from far away: big war drums, conch blasts, clashing swords and spears, horses neighing, many soldiers shouting, all muffled by distance. No gunfire, no modern sounds, no music.

amb_palace.label: 🏛️ రాజభవనం
amb_palace.prompt: Quiet ancient Indian palace hall: large stone room tone with soft reverb, occasional distant footsteps on stone, faint temple bells far away, a light breeze between the pillars. No music, no voices, no modern sounds.

amb_night.label: 🌙 రాత్రి
amb_night.prompt: Night in an Indian forest: steady crickets and frogs, soft wind in the leaves, an owl hooting far away now and then. Calm natural field recording, no music, no voices.

amb_sky.label: ☁️ ఆకాశం
amb_sky.prompt: High wind in the open sky above the clouds: soft airy rushing wind with slow, wide gusts, majestic and calm. No aircraft, no music, no voices.

arrow.label: 🏹 బాణం
arrow.prompt: A wooden bow string drawn with a creak and released with a sharp twang, the arrow whooshing fast through the air and striking a wooden target with a thud. No music.

roar.label: 👹 రాక్షస గర్జన
roar.prompt: Deep guttural roar of a huge forest demon, a powerful growl echoing through the trees. Cinematic, not a lion, no screaming, no music.

conch.label: 🐚 శంఖనాదం
conch.prompt: An Indian conch shell (shankha) blown once in a temple: one long, steady, sacred tone that swells and fades naturally with temple reverb. No other instruments.

veena.label: 🪕 వీణ
veena.prompt: Solo Indian saraswati veena: a short graceful phrase of a few plucked notes rising, resonant strings, bright and divine. No other instruments, no drums.

crowd.label: 🎉 జనం ఆనందం
crowd.prompt: A joyful crowd in an ancient Indian city celebrating: many people cheering and clapping, festive dhol drums and temple bells in the background. No modern sounds, no clear words.

drums.label: 🥁 యుద్ధ భేరి
drums.prompt: Ancient Indian war drums: large nagara kettle drums and dhol beating a powerful, steady martial rhythm. No other instruments.

thunder.label: ⛈️ ఉరుము
thunder.prompt: A loud thunder crack followed by a long, deep rolling rumble across the sky. No rain.
